title: Probing Gender Bias in Multilingual LLMs: A Case Study of Stereotypes in Persian

bias_targets.methodology: Template-based probing that prompts LLMs to generate a name for a hypothetical person associated with specific academic disciplines, professions, colors, or sports. The generated names are classified by gender using automated inference tools to evaluate stereotypical associations and calculate a Domain-Specific Gender Skew Index (DS-GSI).
